questions.prompt: What share of the world's population had access to electricity, as of 2023?
questions.insight: Global electricity access has climbed from 71% in 1990 to 92% in 2023, even as a 2022 energy-price shock briefly stalled progress.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's population lived in extreme poverty (on less than $3 a day), as of 2022?

source.name: World Bank (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: About 700 million people live in extreme poverty today — a huge number, but down from roughly 2 billion in 1990, even as world population grew.

questions.prompt: How many billion people worldwide were using the internet, as of 2023?
questions.insight: 5.4 billion people were online in 2023 — about 67% of humanity — but usage in low-income countries still trailed far behind, at 27%.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's adults (age 15+) could read and write, as of 2024?
questions.insight: Global adult literacy has risen from 65% in 1975 to 88% today, even as the world's adult population more than doubled.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's electricity came from renewable sources, as of 2022?
questions.insight: Renewables passed 29% of global electricity generation in 2022 and were projected by the IEA to reach 35% by 2025.
